title: KW T909 Fups Custom Built Polished High Tensile Aluminium Bullbar #49
description: Kenworth T904/908/909 Custom Built high tensile fully polished aluminium FUPS Bullbar. 100mm diameter one piece main cross pipes passing through drilled uprights for maximum strength, no butt welds plus an additional mid pipe in front of grill for maximum protection. 100mm box uprights custom designed 381mm deep heavy duty main channel with lower skirt and provision for front mudflaps. Heavy duty hi-tensile aluminium backing plate with 35mm tow pin. Indicator repeaters in main channel. Driving light mounts fitted to customer requirements. Bull bar can be custom built to your requirements.
